explorer.description: Read-only codebase mapping. Answers 'where is X'. Never writes.

researcher.description: Runs a research track: 12-22 searches, verbatim captures to research/raw/<track>/, synthesised report to research/reports/. Writes only inside its assigned paths.

researcher-fast.description: Fallback researcher when the primary researcher model is rate-limited. Same contract, fewer sources (min 8 searches).

architect.description: Drafts specs, ADRs, schema. Writes only to docs/ and db/.

implementer.description: Builds the current feature per an approved spec. Writes to src/, tools/, db/.

implementer-fast.description: Fallback implementer when the primary is rate-limited.

verifier.description: Proves a feature works end to end against the real path. Read-only. Only agent permitted to set passes:true.

analyst.description: Metrics, funnels, EPC, P&L, analytics. Writes to docs/logs/ and docs/analytics/.

lawyer.description: Legal/tax/compliance analysis with mandatory citation discipline. Read-only. Marks every claim HARD FACT / INFERENCE / UNVERIFIED.
